items.staleness: change-coupling — an item whose evidence or requirement record pointer no longer resolves

exit.detail: to ITEMS-DONE.md on DONE or DROPPED

items.bound: unbounded, declared why: ready-cap 10 bounds the SCHEDULED head and the retirement ratio governs growth; a hard cap on the carrier would force silent drops, which is the failure the carrier exists to prevent

done bodies.writer: tool — lifecycle item close, the atomic move; no other writer
done bodies.staleness: none, declared why: a closure record is history — it accumulates, it does not go stale; growth is the exit question, not a staleness one

exit.recording-act: a ledger decision line naming the compacted range
exit.detail: the retire lane folds bodies past the archive horizon into a summary line — WAVE 4, declared now so the kind has no undeclared stage, not implemented

done bodies.bound: unbounded, declared why: this is the archive — the BACKLOG-DONE.md split of 2026-08-19 exists because 47% of the live carrier was archive; compaction is its control, not a bound

ledger lines.writer: tool for the slots, session for the reason prose
reader: the grade workflow's ledger rejected --for gate
ledger lines.staleness: none, declared why: the ledger is append-only decision history

exit.recording-act: compaction only — a line whose item is DONE and older than the horizon folds into that body's compaction line

ledger lines.bound: unbounded, declared why: one line per decision event, no bodies

JOURNAL entries.writer: session — an incident and its lesson, written by the session that had it
reader: the law or workflow that cites the entry as its basis
JOURNAL entries.staleness: change-coupling — a journal entry nothing cites is stale, and a law carrying no journal pointer has no basis; both are read against the citing artifact, never against the entry's age

exit.recording-act: the citing law or workflow's pointer is the record; an entry leaves only through the retire lane's compaction, which names the folded range in a ledger decision line

JOURNAL entries.bound: unbounded, declared why: one entry per incident, so growth is bounded by the incident rate rather than by a cap — and a cap here would drop the lesson that justifies a law still in force

audits.writer: session — one measurement per file, written once and not revised
reader: the item whose evidence slot cites the audit
the retire lane's walk over every registered kind
audits.staleness: change-coupling — an audit whose measured artifact has changed past the citation it carries no longer measures anything current

exit.recording-act: none is taken: an audit is append-only historical (design §4 row 1), and the recording act for a superseded measurement is the newer audit citing the one it overtakes

audits.bound: unbounded, declared why: append-only historical, one file per measurement; §4 row 1 declares the exit never, so the control on growth is that a measurement is only taken when a question needs it
